6.name: M
6.text: But there was something that bugged me.

8.name: M
8.text: Apparently, the afternoon shift has some kind of program installed on the computer.

9.name: M
9.text: It shows the client’s name, age, Y posts, and even criminal records.

10.name: M
10.text: And it’s part of my job to censor what they say and sell different things based on that.

12.name: L
12.text: Oh, you’re still working that convenience store job.

13.name: L
13.text: But creepy? I don’t think so.

14.name: L
14.text: It’s good to know who you’re talking to.

15.name: L
15.text: Wouldn’t it be bad if you had to service someone who spouted some bad shit on the internet?

16.name: L
16.text: Or a really horrible weirdo who wanted to gut you open.

17.name: L
17.text: Better to keep away from these people, right?

18.name: L
18.text: That way, you have some way to *control* who you’re working for.

20.name: L
20.text: Come on, just keep working like you always do and you’ll be fine!

21.name: L
21.text: No need to overthink it, okay?
